technique_notes: fibonacci_sphere_positions: θ = arccos(1−2(i+0.5)/n) gives equal-area latitude bands; φ = 2πi/ϕ (ϕ = golden ratio) spaces azimuths to avoid stripes
to_track_quat('-Z','Y'): Blender cameras look toward -Z in local space; +Y is the up axis — this quaternion orient is applied in QUATERNION rotation mode, never Euler (no gimbal lock)
blender_to_nerf_c2w: negate cols 1 and 2 of the 3×3 rotation block; does NOT touch the translation column; this is the exact transform in the nerfstudio Blender data-parser
bpy.context.scene.camera = cam before each render: swaps the active camera that bpy.ops.render.render() uses; reading matrix_world AFTER render ensures depsgraph-evaluated world matrix
fov_x = 2·atan(sensor_w / (2·focal)): horizontal FoV in radians; camera_angle_x in transforms.json uses horizontal convention (nerfstudio expects horizontal)
fl_x = (focal_mm / sensor_w_mm) × img_w: pixel-space focal length; fl_y = fl_x × (img_h / img_w) for square pixels
aabb_scale=4: scene-extent hint for the NeRF/3DGS trainer; RADIUS=3 m fits comfortably inside a 4-unit AABB
Three-point sun-lamp rig: using SUN type (parallel rays) avoids per-view shadow falloff that would confuse 3DGS per-Gaussian colour estimation
os.makedirs(exist_ok=True): idempotent; safe re-run without manual directory cleanup
render to PNG 8-bit: most 3DGS pipelines expect uint8 PNG; EXR/float is not yet supported by mainstream loaders
